record.title: Jordan Iraq Trebil conflict closure
record.imposing_authority: Iraqi authorities imposed the July 2015 closure; Jordanian and Iraqi officials jointly marked formal reopening.
record.enforcement: Formal ceremony observed; AP reported Iraqi processing was initially unready. Normal traffic restart date remains unverified.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.official_rationale: AP attributes the Iraqi closure to denying Islamic State revenue from levies on cargo trucks; highway security was cited in the reopening context.
record.context: Reopening followed Iraqi recovery of highway and customs/security arrangements.
record.uncertainty: July 2015 Iraqi closure to deprive ISIS of truck-tax income is now month-dated. 30 August 2017 was a formal ceremony; AP field report explicitly says normal truck/passenger resumption date was not fixed, and processing remained unready. Do not convert the ceremony into an actual operational endpoint.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established. Month-precision onset and formal endpoint: no exact actual closed-day count.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: AP field reporting describes the Trebil closure and ceremony.

30 August 2017 is the ceremony; AP says no firm normal truck/passenger resumption date was set and processing was initially unavailable.

Hierarchical coding: see Rationale coding for subcategories, attribution and phases. The recorded rationale and claim assessment support the selected subcategories. All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): Closure aimed to deprive Islamic State of truck-tax income.
The Jordan–Iraq Karameh/Trebil crossing is identified; restoration is not all-category operational proof. Limits retained: Trade/passengers, with practical processing not yet established.
The two-year retrospective description does not prove every day and category; no calculated interval retained.
